sourceProfile.scope: LastLevelP6P7 only; excludes backbone and base FPN
sourceProfile.shape_origin: explicit static module profile; not observed

sourceFacts: in_channels != out_channels selects C5, even though the caller p list contains P5.
P6=Conv3 stride2(C5); P7=Conv3 stride2(ReLU(P6)); ReLU is not applied before P6 or to returned P6.
Both P6 and P7 are appended to the existing p list, and matching names append in the same order.
p6 and p7 are independent default-bias Conv families initialized with Kaiming(a=1), bias0.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
